title: Mike Williams and the small bands Vincent got him into
summary: Vincent says Mike Williams played with George McCullum and the small bands Vincent put him in, and tried a comeback after a long layoff.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Ask him who else Mike Williams played with?

He said who else Mike Williams played with? Well he played with Lattes, George McCullum. Just a little bands I got him in. He had got office once here at Lockjaw. And he stayed office so long after me and him got together, you know, he tried to get his comeback. He never could, but he could make out for the fair, you know. We should get a little jobs and work together, you know. What about Willie Warner?
